name: dot-morph
title: Dot Morph
description: A menu dot that splits into three on hover with a gooey neck, then spins and blooms into a three-piece mark on press, with motion blur. Pass your own mark.
author: Petar Cirkovic <https://pettar.com>
docs:
Installed `DotMorph` (`@/components/ui/dot-morph`) and its frame math (`@/components/ui/dot-morph-motion`).

```tsx
import { DotMorph } from "@/components/ui/dot-morph";

<DotMorph size={8} className="text-foreground" />
```

The icon draws in `currentColor`; set the text color to theme it. Hover splits the dot, a press morphs the three dots into the mark and back. Pass `mark` (three closed paths in a 24-unit viewBox) for your own shape, and `colors` to bloom into color.

Ported from the chrome-morph experiment in peckz/playground by Petar Cirkovic (MIT), renamed, with the third-party logo replaced by an original mark; the license notice is at the end of every file.
